items.quote: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring
items.claim: The children of Israel brought a voluntary offering to the LORD
items.actor: The children of Israel / every man and woman

items.quote: whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work
items.claim: The people's willing hearts motivated them to bring materials for the work

items.quote: which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses
items.claim: The LORD commanded work to be made through Moses as agent
